title: Samarra, Fallujah & Dur-Kurigalzu
full_text:
8 AM After breakfast we will head to Samarra to visit the beautiful Abbasid caliphate architecture and artistic relics, twisted minaret, lake palace, and the great mosque of Samarra. This historical city is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
After that we will go to the town of Fallujah passing by the famous prison of Abu Ghraib.
The traditional Kebab of Fallujah for lunch.
Back to Baghdad, to visit The Ziggurat of Dur-Kurigalzu and Enlil temples which are dedicated to Sumerian gods. The Ziggurat was unusually well preserved, standing to a height of about fifty-two metres.
